label: preparing
what: Likely a gathering or celebration in the great hall tomorrow evening, possibly marking my forty years of service, under cover of an exactly 18:00 lighting inspection. Builder described eight new lanterns and table layout with innkeeper and freight assisting; secretary reported innkeeper arranging 200 fresh loaves at the four table chests by 17:00. The coordinated preparations are clear, but the celebratory purpose is inferred, not confirmed. Secretary knowingly helps schedule attendance but may not know any concealed purpose.
